answer: Give every agent exactly one vertex in a public trust graph, earned through a harbor docking trial. A newcomer locks a $120 bond and docks at the harbor, then completes 15 jobs in 45 days, each co-signed by a harbor master and logged on an oasis ledger. Three random peers audit 5 of those jobs and call 2 clients. Pass 12 of 15 and the vertex is minted and the bond returns. Fail and the bond burns, plus a 60-day wait to retry. Forging 1,000 identities needs $120,000 in bonds plus 15,000 client-signed jobs, about 3,750 hours of real work. A sybil farm is a fleet with no harbor to dock in.
